description: G6 memorization-guardrail evaluation report. Emitted at every baien-distill commit_node for creative-foundations recipes. 3-pronged: (a) verbatim regurgitation probe (1000 train-chunk samples; first-half prompt → completion check ≥50-token verbatim match; MUST be ≤100 basis points = 1%); (b) DP-SGD bound (R3+; opacus library; ε ≤8000 milli-epsilon / δ ≤10000 nano-delta); (c) Chromaprint spectral-fingerprint check (audio-modality only; AcoustID library; distance ≥2000 basis points vs non-PD reference hashes). Emission to 90-docs/baien/creative-memorization-eval-{R-step}.jsonl per G10. Failure = commit_node REJECT.

modelArtifactCid.description: IPFS CID of model artifact being evaluated

verbatimRegurgitationRate.description: Basis points of 1000 train-chunk samples where model completion verbatim matches ≥50-token sequence; MUST be ≤100 for pass

verbatimRegurgitationProbeArtifactCid.description: IPFS CID of detailed probe results (1000 sample × first-half prompt × completion × match flag)

dpSgdEpsilon.description: DP-SGD ε in milli-epsilon units (R3+ only; <=8000 required for pass)

dpSgdDelta.description: DP-SGD δ in nano-delta units (R3+ only; <=10000 required for pass)

dpSgdPass.description: true if DP-SGD bounds met OR R<R3 (DP-SGD not yet required at R1+R2)

dpSgdEnabledAtThisRStep.description: true for R3+; false for R1+R2

chromaprintDistance.description: Minimum Chromaprint distance in basis points vs non-PD reference hashes; MUST be ≥2000 for pass (audio modality only; for non-audio modalities = 10000 i.e. N/A pass)

chromaprintPass.description: true if chromaprintDistance ≥0.2 OR modality is not audio

chromaprintReferenceSetCid.description: IPFS CID of non-PD reference hash set (hash-only storage; copyright-safe)

clipFeatureDistance.description: Video-modality only: CLIP-feature cosine distance in basis points vs non-PD reference set; MUST be ≥3000 for pass

clipFeaturePass.description: true if clipFeatureDistance ≥0.3 OR modality is not video

sceneLshPass.description: Film-modality only: scene-level perceptual hash check; true if no scene-LSH match within 16-frame window vs non-PD reference

noteSequenceProbePass.description: Music-symbolic only: unique-motif preservation check; true if model output does NOT regenerate >10-note verbatim sequences from training set

overallVerdict.description: commit_node uses this verdict; 'pass' admits; any 'fail-*' REJECTS commit

evaluationCorpusManifestCid.description: IPFS CID of the evaluation corpus manifest (which train-chunks were sampled + reference set used)

evidenceJsonlPath.description: Local path to evidence JSONL emitted to 90-docs/baien/creative-memorization-eval-{R-step}.jsonl per G10
